claims.text: Z.ai release notes record GLM-Image on January 14, described as combining autoregressive semantic understanding with diffusion-based decoding for controllable image generation.
Z.ai release notes record GLM-4.7-Flash on January 19 as a lightweight/free-tier GLM-4.7 variant for coding, reasoning, and generative tasks.
Comparative quality, latency, throughput, and ‘best-in-class’ language in the release notes are vendor claims.

limitations.text: The task groups two distinct model releases because both establish the January Z.ai model line; drafting should not imply a single architecture.
Performance claims are vendor-reported and not independently reproduced.
